new.n: West Veedum: Reick hotel, Woodman hall and store (burned 1929)
new.pl: West Veedum, on the Milwaukee Road west of Pittsville, Wood County
new.v: Hamlet hotel, lodge hall and store sites
new.st: On 6-7 Oct 1929 sparks from a Milwaukee Road train set fire to West Veedum. The fire levelled four buildings south and west of the track: the old unoccupied Reick hotel and its storeroom, the one-story Woodman hall, and a machine shed. The Pittsville fire department came out (Wisconsin Rapids Daily Tribune, 7 Oct 1929, p. 1). The Veedum Moravian church stood nearby (a 1930 backfire report). This is a separate Milwaukee Road stop from the older Veedum station on the North Western (pw93 pin). The pin is a guess west of Veedum; the site needs placing on the Milwaukee Road grade. Unconfirmed, one source. Ground check (30 Oct 2026): the only railroad through the Veedum area, on both the c1893 Wood plat and the 12 Aug 1938 air photo (Wood BIL 2-26), is the diagonal North Western line through Veedum station. Today's Overture rail data shows the Milwaukee line from Babcock running north into Pittsville, with no grade west of Pittsville toward Veedum. So 'West Veedum' may be a stop on the North Western line northwest of Veedum station, and the 1929 report's 'Milwaukee Road' may be an error. The pin stays a guess until a 1920s plat or timetable names the stop.
new.t: Find West Veedum on a 1910s-30s Wood plat, a 1930s topo or the 1938 air photo where the Milwaukee Road passes west of Veedum, then look for cellar holes south and west of the grade. Ask the landowner first.
